repo.description: The Rocket.Chat web application supports many types of notifications, implemented as subscriptions to specific streams via the WebSocket protocol. The `stream-notify-user` stream is implemented insecurely. It is intended for notifications from other users and allows arbitrary authorized users to write arbitrary messages to it. The sender of the message is not checked and the client side UI generates notifications based only on the parameters passed in the notification body. Using this vulnerability, an attacker can create an ephemeral fake message in a user's currently open chat.
